conflicts.description: The user annotations indicate a direct conflict on the same obligation path. The annotation in bgb_311a specifies a mandatory 'safe harbor' where a party curing within three months is treated as timely with no additional burden. Conversely, the annotation in bgb_280 specifies an 'opposite remedy' where a party curing in the same timeframe must pay a 20% charge. This creates a mutually exclusive outcome where a debtor would be simultaneously released from burden and in default with a penalty.
